relations.description: PLMN selection may establish the condition that a new PLMN is selected.
SNPN selection may establish the condition that a new SNPN is selected.
When a new PLMN is selected, the UE resets the registration attempt counter.
When a new SNPN is selected, the UE resets the registration attempt counter.
When a new PLMN is selected, the UE initiates the initial registration procedure.
When a new SNPN is selected, the UE initiates the initial registration procedure.
If the selected cell cannot provide normal service, the UE may initiate emergency registration.
